name: @fw/measure-chromium
description: Counts lane, Chromium arm: deterministic per-frame work counts from chromium-headless-shell with BeginFrameControl, in a Linux arm64 container.

scripts.determinism: node src/host.mjs --profile swipe-v1 --label det-a && node src/host.mjs --profile swipe-v1 --label det-b && node src/compare.mjs out/swipe-v1/det-a/counts.json out/swipe-v1/det-b/counts.json
scripts.test:run: node --test --test-concurrency=${VITEST_MAX_WORKERS:-$(node -p "require('../contracts/golden/sched/node-budget.gen.json').workers")} test/pure.test.mjs test/fwcore.test.mjs test/viewport.test.mjs test/premise.test.mjs test/faithful.test.mjs test/fidelity-compare.test.mjs test/stage-mode.test.mjs test/overflow.test.mjs test/profile.test.mjs test/offscreen.test.mjs test/push-cycle.test.mjs test/cols-verdict.test.mjs
